standard-dialogue.npc: Silly fishy! You lookin' like likkle Mogre wid your likkle arms an' wid your likkle legs!
Swim along silly round head fishy!
Dont let dem big skippies eat you!

standard-dialogue-entering-crab-pen.player: I just spoke to Nung, he said it was ok.

standard-dialogue-entering-crab-pen.npc: Well...if Nung say it ok, den go ahead.

standard-dialogue-entering-crab-pen.text: The player enters the crab pen
